title: GIT-Coqalane — Corpus TEI-XML des coq-à-l'âne
notes: Public Huma-Num GitLab repository 'GIT-Coqalane' by Cyril Cano-Arnedo: TEI-XML corpus of the Renaissance coq-à-l'âne epigram genre (poems 1530-1650), one TEI file per poem, reuse under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The collected files (CAA13-Rescript_Esprit_Troublé.xml etc.) match its file naming. Origin verbatim: 'Huma-Num GitLab Coqalane: CAA13-Rescript_Esprit_Troublé.xml'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
